boundary: Every failed witness is retained at zero credit; inherited repository and external-overlay layers remain separate.

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first read-only path-existence projection used an empty pipeline form that PowerShell rejected before returning evidence.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Materialize the bounded candidate paths first and test each literal path without an empty-pipeline expression.
phase_rows.title: PowerShell empty-pipeline existence probe did not parse

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first whole-baton display exceeded the presentation budget and was not treated as a complete read.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Read deterministic UTF-8 line windows through the exact final line and verify the Git-blob digest separately.
phase_rows.title: First activation-baton projection was truncated

phase_rows.failure_signature: One read-only PowerShell guidance inventory stopped at parse time because the bounded script block lacked its final brace.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Use a smaller literal inventory block and retain only complete file reads through EOF.
phase_rows.title: Guidance-inventory block omitted a closing brace

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first complete-file presentation exceeded the useful output window and could not prove an EOF read.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Recover with bounded numbered UTF-8 chunks and validate the declared schema separately.
phase_rows.title: Authorization-state whole-file display was truncated

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first recovery grouped too many numbered chunks and again exceeded the presentation budget.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Read smaller non-overlapping chunks through EOF and record the current mutable state separately from historical cursor prose.
phase_rows.title: Combined authorization-state chunk projection also truncated

phase_rows.failure_signature: A bounded search assumed the source canonical receipt was committed in the repository, but the attributable receipt is external.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Inspect only the established bounded receipt bank and recompute both supplied digests without replaying validation.
phase_rows.title: Repository-local canonical-receipt search returned no match

phase_rows.failure_signature: One wide archive search exceeded its useful window and returned no evidence suitable for source verification.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Use the source canonical script and newest bounded phase receipt directory to resolve exact files directly.
phase_rows.title: Broad temporary-receipt search produced no attributable result

phase_rows.failure_signature: A read-only import search passed a shell-style wildcard as a literal Windows path and returned a syntax error.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Use ripgrep's explicit -g file filter within the verified directory.
phase_rows.title: Windows ripgrep wildcard input was invalid

phase_rows.failure_signature: The no-checkout worktree setup continued after its presentation wrapper returned without a usable session handle.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Inspect the exact Git process and lock, do not duplicate it, and wait for that same scoped operation to finish.
phase_rows.title: Worktree-creation projection outlived its wrapper

phase_rows.failure_signature: One bounded follow-up projection reached its reporting boundary without returning attributable process state.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Recover with literal process, lock, head, branch, and status probes against the same target.
phase_rows.title: Follow-up worktree wrapper produced no output

phase_rows.failure_signature: A read-only status call made while the verified checkout lock remained active reported a partial materialization and received no completion credit.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Wait for the original checkout to finish, confirm lock release, then recheck clean status and exact source head.
phase_rows.title: Status probe observed an incomplete live checkout

phase_rows.failure_signature: The initial four-query official-source search returned more material than the available presentation budget and earned zero source credit.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Repeat only the affected searches in bounded official-domain pairs and retain direct primary or official URLs with explicit status labels.
phase_rows.title: First multi-source web result exceeded context

phase_rows.failure_signature: A combined read-only PowerShell version and module projection completed without attributable output and earned zero environment credit.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Recover with separate scalar runtime-version commands and one bounded Python module-availability JSON probe.
phase_rows.title: Composite environment-version projection returned no payload

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first read-only divergence command passed unquoted @{u}, which PowerShell treated as syntax and converted into an invalid Git revision.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Quote Git upstream shorthand or use a full refs/remotes name in PowerShell.
phase_rows.title: X1 divergence probe let PowerShell parse the upstream shorthand

phase_rows.failure_signature: The patch engine rejected a compound patch that tried to delete and re-add the same three tool paths in one invocation.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Do not target one path with multiple operations in a single apply_patch invocation.
phase_rows.title: First multi-file apply_patch combined delete and add for the same targets

phase_rows.failure_signature: The initial strict five-file mypy execution yielded a live cell and later completed without an attributable stdout or exit receipt.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Split slow strict type checks into bounded dependency groups when the execution surface loses the original completion payload.
phase_rows.title: Five-file strict mypy wrapper lost its completion payload
